# Exploding Topics

> > Discover emerging trends, products, and startups before they go mainstream through real-time trend detection and market intelligence.

Exploding Topics is a trend discovery platform that uses data analysis across Google, YouTube, TikTok, and other platforms to identify trending topics, emerging products, and startup opportunities. The platform provides tools, APIs, and curated insights for entrepreneurs, product researchers, and marketers seeking early-stage market signals.

## Key Topics

- Trend Discovery
- Emerging Products
- Market Intelligence
- Trending Topics
- Startup Tracking
- Trend Analytics
- Website Analytics
- TikTok Trends
- Product Research
- Meta Trends
- Exploding Topics API
- GLP-1 Supplements
- Semrush Integration
- Channel Breakdowns
- Trend Detection Algorithm

## Core Platform

- [Exploding Topics - Discover the hottest new trends](https://explodingtopics.com): Homepage for Exploding Topics trend discovery platform
- [Exploding Topics Features & Use Cases | Trend Discovery Platform](https://explodingtopics.com/platform): Platform overview showcasing features and use cases
- [Current Trends - See What's Trending Now](https://explodingtopics.com/topic): Hub page displaying current trending topics and products
- [Number 1 Trend Newsletter - Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/newsletter): Trend newsletter covering trending topics across Google, YouTube, TikTok

## Trend Discovery Tools

- [Trending Products: Product Research Tool | Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/feature/trending-products): Product research tool for discovering emerging trending products
- [TikTok Add-on: Discover Viral TikTok Products Before They Peak](https://explodingtopics.com/feature/tiktok-add-on): TikTok-specific add-on for discovering viral products early
- [Meta Trends: Curated Industry Trends | Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/feature/meta-trends): Curated industry trends and meta-level market intelligence
- [Channel Breakdown: See Where Trends Are Trending | Exploding Topics](https://explodingtopics.com/feature/channel-breakdowns): Feature showing trend distribution across platforms and channels
- [Product Research Tool for E-commerce Stores | Exploding Topics Pro](https://explodingtopics.com/solutions/et-for-ecommerce): E-commerce solution for product research and trend discovery

## Analytics & Data Access

- [Most Visited Websites in the World - Updated February 2026 | Exploding Topics](https://analytics.explodingtopics.com/website): Real-time rankings of most visited websites with traffic analytics
- [Free Website Traffic Checker by explodingtopics.com](https://tools.explodingtopics.com/website-traffic-checker): Free tool for website traffic analysis powered by Semrush
- [Exploding Topics API: Get emerging trend data faster](https://explodingtopics.com/feature/et-api): API for programmatic access to emerging trend data
